# company_profiles

Company profiles records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="company_profiles", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="company_profiles", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `kind` | string | Top-level filter | Record or service type. Fields and meanings can differ between kinds. Public values represented here: `COMPANY`, `PERSON`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `legal_name` | string | Top-level filter | Legal name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `openings_remaining` | integer | Top-level filter | Openings remaining: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `published_next_version` | integer | Top-level filter | Published next version: version of the named evidence/object. Check applicability and status along with its version. |
| `published_revision_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Published revision minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `region` | string | Top-level filter | Region: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `version` | integer | Top-level filter | Version of the underlying record or evidence, not the benchmark release version. |
